name: New Covenant
overview: The New Covenant, foretold by the Lord in Jeremiah, promises a profound transformation where God's law will be written on the hearts of His people, establishing an intimate relationship between God and Israel. Jesus Christ inaugurates this covenant through His sacrificial blood, as He declares it the new testament given for many. Hebrews highlights that this covenant is superior to the old, founded on better promises and mediated by Christ, making the first covenant obsolete because it was not faultless.
